# Baseline — August 2026

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/measure-baseline.mjs. Re-run it rather than editing
     the numbers; a hand-edited baseline is not a baseline. -->

Measured on a local preview build, 3 runs per cell, medians reported.

**What these numbers are.** Chrome DevTools Protocol throttling at the
Moto G Power profile — 4x CPU slowdown and a Slow-4G network shape. That is an
*emulation*: it slows the main thread and the network by a fixed factor, and it
does not reproduce a real phone's thermal behaviour, its GPU, or its memory
pressure. Field RUM (T-008) is the authority on what visitors actually
experience; this is the number that has to move before that one will.

**What they are not.** They are not Lighthouse scores, deliberately. A
composite score moves for reasons unrelated to the change under test, which
makes it a poor gate; these are the individual metrics the gates in §3.1 name.

## Reading these

| Metric | Google's "good" band (p75 field) | Where this build sits |
|---|---|---|
| LCP | < 2.5 s | 2272 ms on the throttled profile |
| CLS | < 0.1 | 0.2594 |
| INP | < 200 ms | not directly measurable in a lab; the palette-open figure above is the closest proxy |

Long tasks are counted for the whole load-plus-scroll sequence, not only the
initial paint, because a page that loads fast and then blocks for 300 ms when
a section enters is not a fast page.

## Open items this baseline exposed

Two of these were found by taking the measurement, which is the point of
taking it.

**CLS is bimodal on the throttled profile: ~0.0005 or ~0.257, nothing in
between.** The large value is always the same event — `.hero-copy` reflowing
at ~2.1 s, when the deferred stylesheet applies and the hero's contents stop
being laid out by the inlined critical sheet and start being laid out by
Tailwind. Four things were tried and measured:

| Attempt | Result |
|---|---|
| `font-display: optional` + metric-matched fallbacks (measured, not guessed: Clash Display 700 is 813.7px where Arial 700 is 744.8px for "Gaurav Barhate", so `size-adjust: 115%`, not 94%) | kept — removes the font-swap component |
| every `@font-face` moved into the inlined sheet | kept — one moment when faces become known, before first paint |
| the first viewport's internal geometry inlined (`.site-header`, `.hero-copy`, `.hero-scroll-hint`, `.hero-back`, `.grade-wash`, `.film-grain`) | kept — turns 5/5 bad runs into 2/5 |
| a height-reserving `.section-slot` around each lazy section | **reverted** — a reservation smaller than the content causes the shift it was meant to prevent; CLS went to 1.48 |
| making the stylesheet render-blocking again | **rejected** — measured no CLS improvement at all, and costs FCP |

The remaining fix is T-050: split the stylesheet so that everything the first
viewport needs is inlined and the deferred sheet styles only surfaces below
the fold. Duplicating Tailwind utilities by hand into the critical sheet is
not that fix — it was tried, and the duplicates fought the real rules (the
44px coarse-pointer sizing in particular) and added a shift of their own.

**Long-task count is high** — around 50 for a full load-plus-scroll on the
4x-throttled profile. The ticker's priority bands (T-056) drop ambient work
first when a frame runs long, but the count itself is dominated by chunk
evaluation, and the answer to that is fewer, larger chunks rather than a
better scheduler.
